notes.subject: שמן/שמנת
notes.rationale: Three fat-verbs pile up (waxed fat, grown thick, covered) then the kicking — the escalation is the rhetoric.

notes.subject: וינבל
notes.rationale: 'Foolishly despised' — one verb carrying both folly and contempt; rendered 'jira ka boŋbali' (showed as worthless).

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: Second-person 'i lasɔgɔsɔra' breaks into third-person narrative — direct address to Israel inside the song.

translation: Nka Yeshurun dasɔgɔsɔra, a boli ni a sen ye: i lasɔgɔsɔra, i ka sogo bonya, sogo bɛ i nɔ fe; a tɔgila Eloa min y'a dilan, a jira ka boŋbali kabakurun min ye a lasigira ye.

tokens.gloss: a boli ni a sen ye
